evidence_items.explanation: Two preregistered experiments involving 2,582 participants found attitude effects from biased autocomplete suggestions; awareness questions indicated that many affected participants did not recognize the influence. Experiment 2 also found significant attitude shifts after warnings before writing or disclosure afterward; the repository dates publication of these findings to March 15, 2024.
